sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 今天，

sentences.en: Venezuela is in the midst of a bloody month-old protest movement, with demonstrators outraged
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉正处于一场持续一个月、充满血腥的抗议运动之中，示威者对

sentences.en: by the country's dramatic economic collapse and the government's increasingly authoritarian rule.
sentences.zh: 该国剧烈的经济崩溃和政府日益独裁的统治感到愤怒。

sentences.en: A Times reporter's close-up account of what's gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 一位《时报》记者对所发生问题的近距离报道。

sentences.en: It's Monday, May 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月1日，星期一。

sentences.en: This is the scene on the streets of Venezuela's capital city, Caracas, in protest of President
sentences.zh: 这是委内瑞拉首都加拉加斯街头的场景，人们正在抗议尼古拉斯·马杜罗

sentences.en: Nicolas Maduro's government.
sentences.zh: 总统的政府。

sentences.en: This is becoming a country where only one man, one party, is in charge.
sentences.zh: 这个国家正变得只由一个人、一个政党说了算。

sentences.en: And it's a place where they've delayed elections.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还推迟了选举。

sentences.en: They haven't allowed peaceful protests.
sentences.zh: 他们不允许和平抗议。

sentences.en: They've been getting rid of journalists like myself, but far worse.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在驱逐像我这样的记者，甚至还有更糟糕的情况。

sentences.en: There are journalists who have been jailed.
sentences.zh: 有记者被关进了监狱。

sentences.en: There are journalists who have been attacked.
sentences.zh: 有记者遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: The country has taken a huge turn.
sentences.zh: 这个国家发生了巨大的转变。

sentences.en: My colleague Nick Casey has been living in Caracas, reporting on a country on the brink of collapse, until recently, when he was kicked out of Venezuela for that reporting.
sentences.zh: 我的同事尼克·凯西一直住在加拉加斯，报道这个处于崩溃边缘的国家，直到最近，他因为这些报道而被委内瑞拉驱逐出境。

sentences.en: Toward the end of that time, he went on a trip, a drive across Venezuela that captures the story of this moment.
sentences.zh: 在那段时光的末尾，他进行了一次横穿委内瑞拉的公路旅行，记录下了这个时刻的故事。

sentences.en: We went about 1,200 miles, going to almost every section of the country, this long road trip,
sentences.zh: 我们行程约1200英里，几乎走遍了该国的每一个角落，这是一次漫长的公路旅行，

sentences.en: but a road trip that was just having a look at this disaster, which was starting to unfold.
sentences.zh: 但这次旅行只是为了审视这场刚刚开始显现的灾难。

sentences.en: You know, we'd pull over and we found a hospital where we just followed the doctors and who wanted to show us what was going on there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们会中途停车，找到一家医院，跟随那些想向我们展示现状的医生。

sentences.en: They didn't have medicines.
sentences.zh: 他们没有药品。

sentences.en: They didn't have bandages.
sentences.zh: 他们没有绷带。

sentences.en: They didn't have soap.
sentences.zh: 他们没有肥皂。

sentences.en: And even more absurd, they didn't have water.
sentences.zh: 更荒谬的是，他们连水都没有。

sentences.en: Can you imagine that?
sentences.zh: 你能想象吗？

sentences.en: The pumps had broken four months before.
sentences.zh: 水泵四个月前就坏了。

sentences.en: And despite all kinds of complaints and protests to the state governor, no one had come to fix it.
sentences.zh: 尽管向州长提出了各种投诉和抗议，但一直没有人来修理。

sentences.en: So one of the doctors described to us the process of trying to do surgery when you couldn't even wash your hands.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一位医生向我们描述了在连手都洗不了的情况下进行手术的过程。

sentences.en: We went to agricultural heartland Los Llanos of Venezuela and saw huge tracts of land where there was nothing being grown at this point.
sentences.zh: 我们去了委内瑞拉的农业中心地带洛斯亚诺斯，看到大片土地上现在什么都没种。

sentences.en: There's no fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 没有化肥。

sentences.en: People couldn't actually grow their beans.
sentences.zh: 人们实际上无法种植豆类。

sentences.en: There were huge lines for food, for people just trying to get bread at this point.
sentences.zh: 现在人们为了买面包排起了长队。

sentences.en: Something which was almost unimaginable in a country the size of
sentences.zh: 这在委内瑞拉这样一个规模的国家几乎是不可想象的，

sentences.en: Venezuela, which was as rich as Venezuela, a country that has got more oil under the ground than even
sentences.zh: 像委内瑞拉这样富裕的国家，地下的石油储量甚至比现在的

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia does right now.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯还要多。

sentences.en: This is one of the richest parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 这是世界上最富有的地区之一。

sentences.en: And yet it's also a place where you've got people who are standing most of their day just trying to get bread or cornmeal.
sentences.zh: 然而，这里的人们却要把大部分时间都花在排队买面包或玉米粉上。

sentences.en: And often at the end of the line, they find that there's only cooking oil because the shortages are so big.
sentences.zh: 而且排到最后，他们往往发现只剩下食用油了，因为短缺太严重了。

sentences.en: So on this trip, we were seeing that the country was starting to shut down.
sentences.zh: 所以在那次旅行中，我们看到这个国家开始陷入停滞。

sentences.en: How did things get so bad?
sentences.zh: 事情是怎么变得这么糟糕的？

sentences.en: Some people would say that day one for this in Venezuela was the arrival of Hugo Chavez to the presidency.
sentences.zh: 有些人会说，委内瑞拉危机的第一天就是乌戈·查韦斯就任总统之时。

sentences.en: He was someone who had already tried to take power in the country through an attempted coup years before, but this time had won a presidential election outright.
sentences.zh: 他曾在此前几年试图通过政变夺取政权，但这一次他直接赢得了总统选举。

sentences.en: His promise was socialism for a new century, basically.
sentences.zh: 他的承诺基本上是新世纪的社会主义。

sentences.en: This was in the region among leftists.
sentences.zh: 这在当时的左翼人士中，

sentences.en: The big hope.
sentences.zh: 是一个巨大的希望。

sentences.en: Suddenly, you had a country with vast oil resources that had a new leftist vision where instead of
sentences.zh: 突然间，一个拥有巨大石油资源的国家有了一个新的左翼愿景，即不再

sentences.en: distributing this money among the most wealthy and among the foreign oil companies, the idea was going
sentences.zh: 把钱分配给最富有的人和外国石油公司，而是计划

sentences.en: to distribute this among the poor and be able to use this to increase education, to be able to build
sentences.zh: 将其分配给穷人，并利用这些资金来增加教育、修建

sentences.en: more roads, to be able to build more classrooms, really just to be able to lift the barrios, the shantytowns, out of poverty in a way that no one had proposed in years.
sentences.zh: 更多的道路、建造更多的教室，真正让贫民窟摆脱贫困，这种方式是多年来从未有人提出过的。

sentences.en: And this was the perfect time for this because the price of oil almost immediately after he got to
sentences.zh: 这正是完美的时机，因为在他上任后，油价几乎立即

sentences.en: office started to rise to incredible heights, to the point where it was above $100 a barrel.
sentences.zh: 开始飙升至令人难以置信的高度，以至于每桶超过了100美元。

sentences.en: So you had all of this money being pumped into everything from new houses to new infrastructure projects.
sentences.zh: 所以所有的钱都被投入到从新住房到新基础设施项目的方方面面。

sentences.en: When elections would come up, these were great times in Venezuela because Hugo Chavez would just literally go
sentences.zh: 当选举来临时，那是委内瑞拉的美好时光，因为乌戈·查韦斯会直接

sentences.en: around the country handing out refrigerators and food and all kinds of things to try to get people to vote for him.
sentences.zh: 走遍全国，分发冰箱、食物和各种东西，试图让人们投票给他。

sentences.en: This was sort of democracy, socialism and capitalism, kind of all of their extremes.
sentences.zh: 这是一种民主、社会主义和资本主义的结合，某种程度上是它们各自极端形式的混合。

sentences.en: You said that as popular as he is, that day one of this crisis can be established with the arrival of Chavez.
sentences.zh: 你说尽管他很受欢迎，但这场危机的第一天可以追溯到查韦斯的到来。

sentences.en: What did he do wrong while so many people thought what he was doing was right?
sentences.zh: 当许多人认为他所做的是正确的时候，他到底做错了什么？

sentences.en: This is often the debate between economists and ordinary people.
sentences.zh: 这通常是经济学家和普通民众之间的争论点。

sentences.en: Economists often take the long view for how do you create a healthy economy in a country, and populism takes the short view of how do you make people happy.
sentences.zh: 经济学家通常从长远角度考虑如何创造健康的经济，而民粹主义则采取短期视角，考虑如何让人们感到快乐。

sentences.en: And in Venezuela, there was a contradiction between those two things.
sentences.zh: 在委内瑞拉，这两者之间存在矛盾。

sentences.en: By giving away so much of the state money, Hugo Chavez was able to raise the fortunes in the short term for so many
sentences.zh: 通过发放如此多的国家资金，乌戈·查韦斯能够在短期内提高委内瑞拉许多人的财富，

sentences.en: people in Venezuela and give them opportunities that they never had.
sentences.zh: 并给予他们从未有过的机会。

sentences.en: But he also closed a lot of the long term possibilities for Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 但也关闭了委内瑞拉许多长期的可能性。

sentences.en: And the main thing was that the state oil company, so much of the money was diverted away from it, that in the end, he started to kill the goose that was laying the golden egg.
sentences.zh: 最主要的是，国家石油公司的资金被大量挪用，最终，他开始杀掉那只下金蛋的鹅。

sentences.en: This is a disaster for Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 这对委内瑞拉来说是一场灾难。

sentences.en: Unsustainable public spending in the last decade has combined with a severe drop in the oil prices, leaving this crude exporting nation almost on its knees.
sentences.zh: 过去十年不可持续的公共支出，加上油价的严重下跌，使这个原油出口国几乎陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: A lot of that money went into the social programs and the source of that money, state oil company, started to crumble.
sentences.zh: 大部分资金用于社会项目，而这些资金的来源——国家石油公司——开始崩溃。

sentences.en: The Venezuelan economy has been in free fall for years after oil prices collapsed, leading to widespread shortages of food, water, medicine and other essentials.
sentences.zh: 在油价崩盘后，委内瑞拉经济多年来一直处于自由落体状态，导致食品、水、药品和其他必需品普遍短缺。

sentences.en: In Venezuela, the International Monetary Fund expects inflation will increase by more than 1,600 percent this year and almost 3,000 percent next year.
sentences.zh: 国际货币基金组织预计，今年委内瑞拉的通货膨胀率将增加超过1600%，明年将增加近3000%。

sentences.en: One man once told me that he had paid for his house years back with the same amount of bolivars that would cost to buy a cell phone right now.
sentences.zh: 有个人曾告诉我，他几年前买房支付的玻利瓦尔金额，现在只够买一部手机。

sentences.en: I, when I first arrived there, would have to get cash by going to the bank and coming out with just literally stacks of 100 bolivar bills.
sentences.zh: 我刚到那里时，必须去银行取现，出来时手里拿着的简直就是一叠叠100玻利瓦尔的钞票。

sentences.en: 100 bolivar was the highest dog denomination when I was there.
sentences.zh: 我在那里时，100玻利瓦尔是面值最大的钞票。

sentences.en: And your meal might have been 14,000 bolivars.
sentences.zh: 而你的一顿饭可能要14000玻利瓦尔。

sentences.en: That would mean counting out 140 bills just to pay for lunch.
sentences.zh: 这意味着仅仅为了支付午餐，就要数出140张钞票。

sentences.en: And then next week, you could expect that lunch was going to be even more expensive than before.
sentences.zh: 而到了下周，那顿午餐的价格可能会比之前更贵。

sentences.en: So Nick, on this drive, as Venezuela's economy is crumbling, you come to this town,
sentences.zh: 那么尼克，在这次驾驶途中，随着委内瑞拉经济的崩溃，你来到了这个城镇，

sentences.en: Maturin, that illustrates so much of what's going on in Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 马图林，它说明了委内瑞拉正在发生的许多事情。

sentences.en: Tell us about that town.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲那个城镇吧。

sentences.en: The town of Maturin is basically an oil boomtown.
sentences.zh: 马图林镇基本上是一个石油繁荣城镇。

sentences.en: There's oil rigs that you can see.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到石油钻井平台。

sentences.en: Some of them are idle everywhere.
sentences.zh: 其中一些到处都处于闲置状态。

sentences.en: You can see the flares of oil wells still on the horizon line.
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以在地平线上看到油井燃烧的火光。

sentences.en: The whole city had different connections to the oil industry all over.
sentences.zh: 整个城市在各处都与石油工业有着不同的联系。

sentences.en: Many people came there because there were lots of oil jobs.
sentences.zh: 许多人来到这里是因为有很多石油工作岗位。

sentences.en: This was how the roads got paved.
sentences.zh: 这就是道路铺设的方式。

sentences.en: You know, this also used to be a city where you'd have many immigrants from different parts of Europe or the US, people would come to work for the oil
sentences.zh: 你知道，这里曾经也是一个有很多来自欧洲或美国不同地区移民的城市，人们会来为石油

sentences.en: services companies or actually work for the state oil company itself.
sentences.zh: 服务公司工作，或者实际上为国家石油公司本身工作。

sentences.en: It was a cosmopolitan kind of place because of its connection to the rest of the world through oil.
sentences.zh: 因为它通过石油与世界其他地区相连，所以它是一个国际化的地方。

sentences.en: But it's totally collapsed.
sentences.zh: 但它已经完全崩溃了。

sentences.en: You know, it was a place where people used to have fancy cars.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这里曾经是人们拥有豪车的地方。

sentences.en: Now it's a place where people barely go outside anymore.
sentences.zh: 现在这里的人们几乎不再出门了。

sentences.en: It's a place where people are spending most of their day simply trying to find food as opposed to living an ordinary life.
sentences.zh: 这里的人们把大部分时间都花在寻找食物上，而不是过普通的生活。

sentences.en: So in this town, you met a woman who had just lost her job and who had a son, Kevin, whose story she told you about.
sentences.zh: 在这个城镇，你遇到了一位刚失业的妇女，她有一个儿子叫凯文，她向你讲述了他的故事。

sentences.en: So we got to Kevin's mother's home.
sentences.zh: 我们到了凯文母亲的家。

sentences.en: Her name was Yamilet Lugo.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫亚米莱特·卢戈。

sentences.en: And the first thing we noticed was just how thin she was herself.
sentences.zh: 我们注意到的第一件事就是她自己有多瘦。

sentences.en: She lost an amount of weight.
sentences.zh: 她瘦了很多。

sentences.en: Everybody in the house had.
sentences.zh: 屋里的每个人都瘦了。

sentences.en: And the family was collecting some subsidies from the government, but those started to vanish too.
sentences.zh: 这家人正在领取政府的一些补贴，但那些补贴也开始消失了。

sentences.en: So the daily question was how they were going to get food.
sentences.zh: 所以每天的问题是他们如何获得食物。

sentences.en: It got to a stretch where no one in the family was eating and everybody was basically sitting around in this house and starting to get more hungry every day.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，家里没有人吃东西，每个人基本上都坐在屋里，每天都感到越来越饿。

sentences.en: They made the decision like a lot of people in this neighborhood were that they were going to start looking for food that was growing out in the wild.
sentences.zh: 他们像这个社区的许多人一样做出了决定，开始寻找野外生长的食物。

sentences.en: And they had found a plot where there was some edible yucca that was growing, but eventually they couldn't get to that plot.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了一块地，那里长着一些可食用的木薯，但最终他们无法到达那块地。

sentences.en: So they tried to go somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 所以他们尝试去别的地方。

sentences.en: This was a place they'd heard of where there was also something that they could eat that was growing, but it wasn't the edible variety of yucca.
sentences.zh: 这是他们听说过的一个地方，那里也有可以吃的东西在生长，但那不是可食用的木薯品种。

sentences.en: It was a variety which called yucca amarga, which is bitter yucca, which is poisonous.
sentences.zh: 那是一种叫做苦木薯的品种，是有毒的。

sentences.en: They ate it for dinner that night and everybody in the family started to feel a little strange.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上他们吃了它作为晚餐，家里每个人都开始感到有点奇怪。

sentences.en: But Kevin, it seemed he'd eaten some more because he was suddenly starting to vomit.
sentences.zh: 但凯文似乎吃得更多，因为他突然开始呕吐。

sentences.en: He had these terrible stomach cramps.
sentences.zh: 他有严重的胃痉挛。

sentences.en: Yamilet, the mother said she looked at his face and she saw it was totally white.
sentences.zh: 母亲亚米莱特说，她看着他的脸，发现它完全变白了。

sentences.en: They knew they needed to get him to the hospital as quickly as they could, but it took hours before they were even able to get someone to lend them car to be able to get there.
sentences.zh: 他们知道必须尽快把他送到医院，但花了几个小时才借到车去那里。

sentences.en: And when they got to the hospital, they got to what is basically typically a Venezuelan
sentences.zh: 当他们到达医院时，他们到达的是基本上典型的委内瑞拉

sentences.en: hospital right now, which has a long waiting line, no medicine, and really no way to treat you.
sentences.zh: 医院，那里有长长的排队，没有药，也没有办法治疗你。

sentences.en: So the mother told me that they were waiting hours before they got anyone to even be able to see Kevin.
sentences.zh: 所以母亲告诉我，他们等了几个小时才有人来看凯文。

sentences.en: And when they did, they actually sent the family out to get basic intravenous solutions.
sentences.zh: 当他们终于看到他时，他们实际上让家人出去买基本的静脉注射液。

sentences.en: These hospitals don't have intravenous solutions right now.
sentences.zh: 这些医院现在没有静脉注射液。

sentences.en: They're telling families to go out and try to find things on their own.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉家人自己出去设法寻找东西。

sentences.en: Themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们自己。

sentences.en: Themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们自己。
